title: Motorboatin' Joes Eliminate King Cobras 3-1 in Playoff Battle
description:
Globo Gym King Cobras D vs. Motorboatin' Joes D — Game #8627 (Playoff)
Final Score: Motorboatin' Joes 3 – King Cobras 1
Date: 09/03/26 • League: BH Adult D • Location: Baptist Health Iceplex Rink 2
Period by Period: King Cobras 0-1-0 (1) | Motorboatin' Joes 1-1-1 (3)

Motorboatin' Joes struck first on the power play and never trailed, adding an insurance goal in each of the next two periods to eliminate King Cobras in a low-event, well-officiated playoff game that saw just one penalty called all night.

🥅 Goal Timeline

1st Period
7:50 (PP) — Michael Perez (Motorboatin' Joes), assisted by Joshua Herman. 1-0

2nd Period
7:40 — Matthew Killeen (King Cobras), unassisted. 1-1
3:50 — Kyle Ramqvist (Motorboatin' Joes), assisted by Ryan Roach. 1-2

3rd Period
12:52 — Kyle Ramqvist (Motorboatin' Joes), assisted by Orlando Garcia. 1-3 FINAL

🚨 Penalty Timeline

1st Period
7:52 — Matthew Killeen (King Cobras) — Tripping, 2 min (power play ended early — Perez's PP goal came just 2 seconds after the penalty started)

📝 Game Notes
A tight, disciplined playoff game decided by special teams: Motorboatin' Joes' only power play of the night produced the opening goal just seconds into Killeen's tripping minor. King Cobras tied it up in the second on Killeen's own goal, but Kyle Ramqvist's two-goal night, one in each of the final two periods, was enough to see the Joes through. Only one penalty was called in the entire game.
